claims.claim: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman stated the Artemis 3 mission will spend 14 to 17 days in low Earth orbit next summer practicing sequential docking of Orion with prototype landers from SpaceX and Blue Origin.
claims.episode_span: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman stated the Artemis 3 mission will spend 14 to 17 days in low Earth orbit next summer practicing sequential docking of Orion with prototype landers from SpaceX and Blue Origin.
claims.source_title: NASA Reaffirms 2028 Crewed Moon Landing, With Back-to-Back Starship and Blue Moon Docking Tests Next Year
claims.supporting_quote: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman used the occasion to reiterate the plan for a crewed moon landing in 2028. To that end, the Artemis 3 mission will spend 14 to 17 days in Earth orbit next summer, practicing sequential docking procedures with prototype lunar landers being developed separately by SpaceX and Blue Origin.

claims.claim: SpaceX seeks to expand the Roberts Road site from 167 acres to nearly 400 acres to support Starship operations ahead of Flight 16.
claims.episode_span: The company seeks to grow the site from 167 acres to nearly 400 acres to support Starship operations ahead of Flight 16.
claims.source_title: Possible Roberts Road Expansion as SpaceX pushes for Flight 16
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX, in conjunction with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), has applied to expand its Roberts Road campus from 167 acres to nearly 400 acres.

claims.claim: Boeing has completed Starshield work on nine C-17 aircraft under contracts totaling $13.5 million, with plans to equip 19 jets by March.
claims.episode_span: Technicians at Port San Antonio have completed work on nine jets under two contracts totaling $13.5 million.
claims.source_title: Boeing Installs SpaceX Starshield on C-17s in San Antonio
claims.supporting_quote: Boeing technicians at Port San Antonio have started bolting SpaceX's military-grade satellite internet system onto Air Force C-17 Globemaster cargo jets, with nine aircraft already finished and more on the way. Two contracts worth a combined $13.5 million cover the work of integrating the system.
